claims: Geno Auriemma is the head coach of the UConn Huskies women's basketball team.
Geno Auriemma has held the position of head coach of the UConn Huskies women's basketball team since 1985.
Geno Auriemma is the winningest coach in NCAA basketball history.
Geno Auriemma has led the UConn Huskies to 12 NCAA Division I national championships.
Geno Auriemma has led the UConn Huskies to 24 Final Four appearances.
Geno Auriemma holds the NCAA record for most wins as a basketball coach.
Geno Auriemma has over 1,200 wins as a basketball coach.
Geno Auriemma holds the NCAA record for the highest winning percentage as a basketball coach.
Geno Auriemma has been with UConn since the 1985-86 season.
Geno Auriemma has been inducted into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame.
Geno Auriemma has been inducted into the Women's Basketball Hall of Fame.
Geno Auriemma's contract has been extended through April 2029.
